change.summary: A detector step (simplex deletion certification, rectifier detection and certification, Mu candidate and certification) whose admitted retained-CG projection fails with NonConvergence or InvalidData is executed once more with the public LSMR solver family under the same weights, tolerances, iteration limit, decision rules and certificates; the LSMR workspace is bounded on generation zero and charged to the live memory plan only when used. If it does not fit or also fails numerically, the first error is reported. Public default otherwise unchanged; hidden Auto arm resolves no re-execution.

diagnosis.ir_span_class: Cells (5,1) (5,2) (11,1) (11,2) (17,1) (17,2), r(430) 'direction failed certification'. Retained CG solves the rectifier projection on the weighted normal equations; the zero-row weight tolerance^2/zeros (6e-19 at 150-170 zeros) is squared, so zero-row components are lost to rounding (seed 11 iteration-1 projection scale 1.58e4 for a recurrence in [0,1]; scales then wander over ten iterations). The proposed direction (-fitted, fitted = response - residual) leaves the model span: independent numpy lstsq span distance 0.144 (seed 11), 0.193 (17), 2.0e-8 (5) against projection_tolerance 1e-10, equal to fereg's own span certificate. Tightening the FE tolerance to 1e-12 does not help (CG breaks down). The decision rule is not at fault: with an accurate projection the same rule proposes the LP-witness set.
diagnosis.simplex_score_class: Cells (10,0) (14,0) (16,0), r(459) 'finite score certificate did not pass'. The unit-weight span check of an exact simplex direction lying in the FE span: the within response is FE-solver noise (8.8e-16, 8.6e-9, 2.3e-8 against |z| ~ 1), and the deferred absorbed intercept's raw moment is normalized by max(within response, residual) norm, giving 1.33e-10, 1.11e-10, 1.47e-10 against score tolerance 1e-10 while the residual (span distance) is <= 2e-14. The FE certificate of the residual absorption is scaled by the raw RHS and never asks for that orthogonality.
diagnosis.seed_3: Cells (3,1) (3,2) still fail in both arms. The CG direction is the LP-witness set (20 rows) but its span distance is 1.825e-10 (lstsq 1.8249e-10) over projection_tolerance 1e-10; LSMR's residual absorption ends at FE relative moment 1.149e-8 over 1e-8; CMG and Auto exhaust their budgets. Not changed.
diagnosis.rejected_candidates: Shared score-certificate normalization (also gates PPML IRLS; not narrow); larger CG budget or tighter FE tolerance (CG breakdown); explicit CMG for detector projections (fixes the IR class only, two/three intercept FEs only).

hidden_budget_exhaustions.cells: (9,1) (9,2): DensePanel 240 rows 12x10, unit weights, zero fraction 0.45, induced regressor separation; configurations fe ir and ir.
hidden_budget_exhaustions.where: Generation 0, rectifier iteration 1 of 10,000: the first detector projection. The rectifier's iteration limit is not consumed and no pilot or handoff is involved: the initial absorption (4 RHS) certifies after 5 two-FE PCG iterations; the final residual absorption's PCG stops at iteration 0 on its recurrence proxy (target 5e-9 relative to the original RHS reference norms) while the independent FE certificate fails.
hidden_budget_exhaustions.why: Final residual absorptions run with ols_refine = Some(false) (borrowed_map.rs absorb_ols_with_remaining), so no tighter PCG correction is attempted, and the fail-safe symmetric MAP continuation runs the remaining 16,000-iteration budget on the 9e-19-weighted system without certifying (0.13 s). The FE certificate and tolerance are the same as retained CG's; CG certifies the same residual after 8 iterations. Forcing the correction (recurrence 1e-10) still stops at iteration 0, so the proxy and the certificate measure different scales on this residual. An LSMR re-execution of the hidden step also fails.
hidden_budget_exhaustions.fix_would_need: A two-FE PCG stop for detector residual absorptions normalized like the FE certificate (current residual rather than original RHS reference norms), or a certified non-MAP fallback (retained CG certifies these cells) when the proxy stop misses the certificate. Either changes the hidden route; not implemented.

seed_9_fix.diagnosis: Census seed 9 (fe ir, ir): the first rectifier projection's final residual absorption on the Auto route stops at two-FE PCG iteration 0 with an accurate residual (exact relative FE moments <= 2.7e-10), but the categorical FE certificate computes 1.0614682285731785e-8 > 1e-8. That certificate forms each level mean as the first member's value plus a compensated sum of weighted differences; when the first member is a zero-outcome row with residual of order one, positive-row residuals (~1e-18) vanish in their differences and the mean carries one ulp of the shift, ~1e-8 relative to the rectifier's weighted residual norm 9.06e-9. A Python emulation reproduces the computed value bit for bit. MAP corrections are below one ulp: 16,000 sweeps leave every bit and the certificate unchanged. Retained CG certifies after further iterates (exact moments 1.1e-20, certificate 8.5e-21). A PCG stop scaled like the certificate would not remove the floor.
seed_9_fix.fix: An Auto-routed detector step that fails a numerical certificate runs once more as retained CG under the same admitted budget, weights, tolerances, iteration limit, rules and certificates, then continues exactly as a retained-CG step (LSMR re-execution included); if it fails as well, the retained-CG step's error is reported. The Auto attempt takes no two-FE PCG MAP continuation (AbsorbConfig::certified_fallback off; borrowed_map absorb_ols_declining_map_continuation), so a miss returns NonConvergence before the MAP loop.
seed_9_fix.witnesses: Full fingerprints of all 108 census arm-cells (separation report with certificate magnitudes, sample, e(b)/e(V) bits, errors) at 1 and 4 workers bit-identical to 2d70e880 except hidden (9,1) (9,2) (now complete with the LP-witness sample) and (3,1) (3,2) (now the retained-CG error). Census classes: 39 same, 15 ir-iterations. Unit tests: declined continuation (misses and breakdowns -> NonConvergence; certified results bit-identical) and the Auto policy chain.

seed_3.evidence: 60-digit mpmath reference projection of the first rectifier recurrence: exact direction flags the 20 LP-witness rows, span 6.2e-19. Retained CG: fitted errors up to 2.34e-10 on zero rows only (4.9e-17 on positive rows; u - r formation exact), invisible to the weighted FE certificate at weight 1e-18 but rejected by the unit-weight span check (1.8249e-10 > 1e-10). LSMR and Auto: directions accurate (span 3.3e-17 and 1.7e-12, same 20 rows) but their residuals fail the FE certificate's first-member-shift floor (computed 1.149e-8 and 4.25e-8 vs exact 6.3e-23 and 1.2e-18; unchanged under 20 random summation orders).
options: Certificate arithmetic: shift each level by its largest-weight member (emulation gives the exact moments: 6.3e-23, 1.2e-18, seed 9 2.7e-10); shared with OLS, needs its own scope; narrow variant re-certifies that way only after a first-member failure (bit-identical whenever the current certificate passes).

Certify the span check's unit-weight projection of the direction when only the span check fails (seed 3: same 20 rows, span 2.4e-16, boundary 1.1e-10, interior 9.2e-11); a certificate-procedure change.
